correctness.rationale: Exact monomial-moment isometry identifies transverse degree slices with the corresponding weighted Bergman space (Hardy at degree zero) and the distinguished generalized Cesàro parameter. The published one-block essential-circle and subnormality theorems give Fredholmness and norm 2/(r+1); direct recurrence proves absence of eigenvalues and a one-dimensional adjoint defect inside each block disk. Norm-decay makes the infinite tail uniformly invertible for nonzero λ. Counting the finite contributing blocks with their transverse binomial multiplicities gives the corrected hockey-stick index formula. The union is closed because circles shrink to 0, itself in the union. Finite checker passes 17796 independent exact-arithmetic checks of moments, formal eigenrecurrences, finite-support adjoint vectors and index regions.

value.rationale: This gives the natural complete Fredholm classification of the recently defined d-variable coordinate Cesàro operator. Its ordinary spectrum is a single filled disk in every dimension, but the Fredholm essential spectrum comprises infinitely many tangent circles, and the exact binomial index staircase has order a dimension-determined power law near zero. The index thus reveals the complex dimension; it is a structural spectral invariant rather than a minor numerical refinement or a restatement of one-variable spectra.
